targetNarrativeEvidence.meaning: Position the pan-Amazonian table in Sao Paulo and expose reservation and Banda actions.
Make the Banda the protagonist and explain its shared-table ritual.
Connect fish, fruit, forest, people, and knowledge without turning the page into a long manifesto.
Build trust through the traceable journey from community and producer to Sao Paulo.
Convert interest into a house choice and reservation intent.

influenceAudits.influence: dark field, sparse spacing, and restrained contrast
influenceAudits.sourceMeaning: Provides a focused visual field for footage and editorial product claims.
influenceAudits.targetEquivalent: DaSelva can use the same restraint to establish atmosphere and focus the central thesis.
influenceAudits.reason: These formal attributes remain coherent after source media, copy, product identity, and motion are removed.

influenceAudits.influence: scattered footage distributed around the hero
influenceAudits.sourceMeaning: Represents multiple raw video clips before editorial organization.
influenceAudits.targetEquivalent: The frozen DaSelva hero has multiple ingredients and places, but it does not define them as disordered material awaiting organization.
influenceAudits.reason: The static arrangement may survive as decoration, but decoration is not sufficient justification for a high-impact hero system.

influenceAudits.influence: scattered footage converges into a timeline or editable narrative
influenceAudits.sourceMeaning: Communicates the product promise that raw footage becomes a structured, editable cut.
influenceAudits.targetEquivalent: No timeline, editing, sorting, or organization event exists in the frozen DaSelva content.
influenceAudits.reason: Reusing the choreography would faithfully reproduce an effect that tells the wrong story.

influenceAudits.influence: full-bleed moving-image plane with quiet navigation and restrained overlay type
influenceAudits.sourceMeaning: Lets photographic and film work remain the protagonist while interface and explanation recede.
influenceAudits.targetEquivalent: The frozen DaSelva plan requires the Banda to receive the largest or joint-largest food-media moment while concise text explains the shared-table ritual.
influenceAudits.reason: Source and target share the same causal hierarchy: the primary media carries the experience and the text supports it.

influenceAudits.influence: perspective typographic chamber as a cross-scene transition
influenceAudits.sourceMeaning: Turns the identity and spatial character of a landmark building into an immersive virtual passage.
influenceAudits.targetEquivalent: DaSelva has an evidenced journey from river and origin to the Sao Paulo table, but the content does not require a literal spatial chamber or an aggressive identity tunnel.
influenceAudits.reason: The analogy is plausible but not necessary, while the influence can dominate quieter target-owned scenes.

referenceLevelOutcome.outcome: Remain eligible in the reference bank. Reject only the context-bound hero narrative and motion for this DaSelva allocation.

strategyDecision.nextAction: Stop before generation. Run a separately authorized bounded selection round for a semantically portable W contribution or reduce W only when two references still own material justified subsystems.
